acceptanceCriteria: A test with a sidecar-narrowed reader that has a unit-frontier reason shows the reason retained in the plan's unknown entries (or the suspicion is closed as not reproduced with that test)
body: Suspected by code inspection during PR #1138 Codex round 1 (not reproduced). PR #1138 fixed the same class for AFP-V0-072: readers narrowed away must still name their unit-frontier reasons in Select. The AFP-V0-021 sidecar narrowing path in internal/liveverify/affected/readers.go was left unchanged and may drop them. Expected: a sidecar-narrowed unit's frontier reason is still named.
title: affected: CEM sidecar narrowing (AFP-V0-021) may drop a narrowed unit's frontier reason from the unknown entries (suspected)
